description: Vina Score: mean +/- std AutoDock Vina top-pose kcal/mol across docked molecules per pocket (TargetDiff Table 1 convention; TODO-22 metric #1).
unit: kcal/mol (mean +/- std across pool; lower = better)
source: /mnt/disk1/Hugo_Lee/mol-metal/molmetal/data/mmp13_real/dock_results.csv (100 Lambda click products x PDB 830c x AutoDock Vina 1.2.7, exhaustiveness=8, n_poses=5) + molmetal/reports/mmp13_vina_real.md
candidate_pool: 100 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazoles from a 25-tile azide library x 25-tile terminal-alkyne library, cycled via RDKit CuAAC reaction SMARTS. This is the in-silico materialisation of the Lambda MCTS best_state.smiles for the binder type at this pocket.
note: Single-pocket measurement on 830c (MMP13). The other TODO-22 target pockets (1h36, test_001..test_019) are NOT staged on disk in this snapshot. The mean reflects CuAAC click products against a hydroxamate-pocket (sulphone hydroxamate RS1) — products hit the pocket but not the Zn-coordination site, so the scores are well above the TargetDiff CrossDocked lit -8.45 kcal/mol.
